fact_text: Engro Corporation is a holding company with stakes in several businesses, including infrastructure (towers leased to mobile operators), energy, food and fertilizer, and it has paid dividends for decades.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '2024 Investor Guide: Very Important for Investors!' (YouTube, 2024-01-09)

fact_text: The analyst sees Engro's holding structure, which now includes a mutual-fund-like portfolio, as a route to dividend income, with Engro Infra's mobile-tower assets an upcoming listing.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '2024 Investor Guide: Very Important for Investors!' (YouTube, 2024-01-09)

fact_text: Lucky Cement's plant expansion has taken its capacity to about 15 million tonnes a year, and the analyst calls it a value stock with a track record of delivering on projects, though its dividend is modest.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '2024 Investor Guide: Very Important for Investors!' (YouTube, 2024-01-09)

fact_text: Lucky Motor plans to make CKD parts for its vehicles in Pakistan over time and may move into EVs, depending on how local conditions support it.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '2024 Investor Guide: Very Important for Investors!' (YouTube, 2024-01-09)

fact_text: Fauji Cement's capacity has reached about 10.6 million tonnes a year, and its fourth plant at DG Khan has started production.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '2024 Investor Guide: Very Important for Investors!' (YouTube, 2024-01-09)

fact_text: Fauji Cement has not paid dividends for several years, but the analyst expects payouts to resume, as the company used to pay two dividends a year.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '2024 Investor Guide: Very Important for Investors!' (YouTube, 2024-01-09)

fact_text: Fauji Cement has local demand from housing schemes around Taxila, Wah and Fateh Jang, and from water reservoir projects in KP and Gilgit-Baltistan, where Frontier Works Organization buys its cement.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '2024 Investor Guide: Very Important for Investors!' (YouTube, 2024-01-09)

fact_text: Bank Islami declared a large dividend in 2023 and its profits began to rise sharply after that.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '2024 Investor Guide: Very Important for Investors!' (YouTube, 2024-01-09)

fact_text: The analyst describes Bank Islami as the fully Shariah-compliant bank in Pakistan after Meezan, with a published list of Shariah advisers and products.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '2024 Investor Guide: Very Important for Investors!' (YouTube, 2024-01-09)

fact_text: Islamic banks in Pakistan tend to earn better margins than conventional banks, according to the analyst, which is why he watches their dividends closely.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '2024 Investor Guide: Very Important for Investors!' (YouTube, 2024-01-09)
